desc.ian_image_library:title: Centropomus undecimalis (Common Snook)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: The common snook (Centropomus undecimalis) is a species of marine fish in the family Centropomidae of the order Perciformes. The common snook is also known as the sergeant fish or robalo.
